summary: I am the main author of the AI engines behind two REDQ products: TrueBeep, a marketing platform for e-commerce and local businesses, and PROA, a multi-tenant ERP. I also write a large share of the TrueBeep web app and its job processor, from inbox and campaigns to the workflow builder and the MCP server that lets ChatGPT and Claude work inside a TrueBeep account.

projects.title: TrueBeep AI Engine
projects.what: A Python service that holds every AI feature in TrueBeep: the in-app Copilot, the agent that answers customer messages on its own, content checks, image generation and workflow generation. I wrote most of it, from the first content validation endpoint to the routing layer that keeps each request on the cheapest model that can handle it.
built: Built the Copilot, a streaming business assistant that reads a team's campaigns, customers, analytics, billing and docs through tools, and renders answers as KPI cards, sortable tables, content suggestions and campaign forms.

Built a tiered intent router that classifies each message, then loads only the instruction modules, tools and model that intent needs, falling back from a typed decision call to a small chat model to regex keywords.

Built an auto-reply agent for the unified inbox that answers customers with business documents and history, fills the team's forms from the conversation, adds new contact channels, and flags a human when it should not answer.
Built two-layer memory: a token-capped Redis window of recent turns that drops filler like 'ok' and 'thanks', and long-term memory in ChromaDB with embeddings kept in a separate collection per team.
Built document retrieval: PDF, CSV, Markdown and text parsers, Mistral OCR for scanned documents and invoices, chunking and embeddings into ChromaDB, and an LLM reranker before answering.
Built a conversation evaluator that scores agent replies with sentiment, strengths and weaknesses, which the web app shows as auto-reply analytics.
Built content scans for email, social posts and SMS/WhatsApp messages that check spam signals, phishing patterns, platform rules and unsubscribe links, and return scored suggestions.
Built image generation and editing across OpenAI and several FAL models, with next-edit suggestions, per-image cost lookups and upload to Cloudflare R2.
Built workflow generation that turns a plain request into a valid automation graph (triggers, conditions, delays, email, SMS, WhatsApp, tag and webhook steps) and can edit an existing one.
Built Redis-backed stream buffering so a Copilot reply that is cut off by a crash or deploy can be recovered instead of lost.

projects.title: TrueBeep Web App
projects.what: The main TrueBeep dashboard where businesses manage customers, campaigns, loyalty, social posts, the inbox and AI settings. I have been one of its core engineers since May 2024.
built: Built the media manager with folders, Unsplash and Google Drive pickers, bulk actions and per-team storage quotas.
Built the unified inbox for Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp with real-time updates over WebSockets, unread counts, attachments, story mentions and pause or resume controls for the AI auto-reply.
Built the AI screens: the Copilot chat with threads, to-dos, suggestions and feedback, AI document management, auto-reply analytics, and AI email and social scan modals inside the content editors.
Built a visual workflow builder with triggers, conditions, version history, undo and redo, test runs, execution logs, a template library with AI suggestions and an 'Edit with AI' mode.
Built coupons and loyalty: unique coupon codes, redemption analytics, loyalty points on customer profiles and a wallet pass script for storefronts.
Built the billing pieces: plans, a free plan, balance checks before campaigns and image generation, pending cost tracking and member add-ons.
Built social publishing editors with platform limits for X threads, LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels, plus social analytics views.
Built email setup with domain verification, SES configuration and double opt-in, and SMS 10DLC compliance checks.
Built the OAuth 2.1 server and AI Assistants settings that let ChatGPT, Claude and Codex connect to a TrueBeep account over MCP.
Fixed security issues from an internal review by scoping team data on every query and removing raw SQL sorting.

projects.title: TrueBeep Processor, Public API and MCP Server
projects.what: The event-driven backend that runs campaigns, webhooks, social posting, analytics sync and workflows. I am its third largest contributor and I built its MCP server and public API.
built: Built the MCP server with read tools for coupons, wallet cards, interactions, opt-in pages and connections, and write tools for drafts, content, tags, coupons and opt-in pages.
Added server-enforced confirmation for destructive tools and an SSRF guard after a pre-release security test of the MCP server.
Built public /v1 endpoints for workflows, campaigns and contents, and wrote their reference pages on the docs site.
Built the workflow interpreter with cron lifecycle, segment conditions, birthday triggers, API call, tag and update-field steps.
Built X/Twitter and YouTube posting and analytics processors, LinkedIn comment posting with retries, and hourly social analytics refresh.
Built WhatsApp opt-in verification, coupon code generation through loyalty queue events, and React Email templates for notifications.

projects.title: PROA Brain
projects.what: The AI engine for the PROA ERP, started in January 2026 from the TrueBeep engine. I restructured it for ERP use and added smart routing and modular instructions for the PROA Copilot.
built: Restructured the engine for PROA and removed marketing-only parts.
Added the tiered intent router and modular instruction builder so the PROA Copilot loads only the tools and prompt sections a request needs.
Kept document retrieval with ChromaDB, reranking and Mistral OCR parsing for ERP documents.
Kept short-term Redis memory and long-term vector memory for Copilot threads.
Kept web search and documentation search tools for the Copilot.

projects.title: PROA ERP: Projects, Contracts and Invoice OCR
projects.what: PROA is a multi-tenant ERP covering accounting, procurement, HR, projects and more. I worked mainly on project management and donor contracts, plus OCR for invoices.
built: Integrated Mistral OCR to turn uploaded invoices into structured data with vendor, line items and validation.
Built project configuration: project levels, budget categories, activities, creatable tags and project code generation.
Built strategy revisions that clone outcomes and KRA targets, plus donor indicators and a disaggregation model for KRA targets.
Built donor contract features: version control for revisions, milestones and deliverables with payment percentages, and donor pledge activation on approval.
Built cost recovery with budget line selection and validation, and synced project commitment and spent values across payments, purchase invoices and blanket orders.
Built project closure readiness checks, deadline notifications and delayed approval notifications.
Built project analytics and outcome exports to Excel and PDF, and carbon footprint reporting in project summaries.

operations: Added structured JSON logging for Datadog and OpenTelemetry/Logfire instrumentation to the AI engine.
Kept the AI engine's Docker image and pinned dependencies current, including pinning FastAPI after a release broke tracing.
Updated the Node.js runtime in the web app's Dockerfile and AWS deploy workflow to fix a keep-alive regression.
Migrated AI call sites off OpenAI models scheduled for shutdown.
Wrote database migrations for AI conversations, Copilot threads, feedback, workflows and the MCP OAuth tables.
Wrote docs site sections for the Forms, Analytics, Workflows and Content APIs and the MCP setup guide.
ai: Route each Copilot message by intent and complexity, then load only the matching instruction modules and tools, which keeps prompts short and puts simple requests on a smaller model.

Use a typed decision call for routing and reranking, with a chat model and then regex keywords as fallbacks, and skip the decision tier for a cooldown when it keeps failing instead of failing every message.
Track token usage and cost per agent run, record it against the team, and check the team's balance before auto-replies, image generation and campaigns.
Cache Copilot to-do suggestions in team metadata so they are not regenerated on every visit.
Keep short-term memory under a token budget and filter trivial messages before they take up context.
Isolate each team's vectors in its own ChromaDB collection.
Retrieve, then rerank chunks with an LLM before answering from business documents.
Give the auto-reply agent a human handover tool so it can stop and flag a person instead of guessing.
Build instructions at request time from the team's profile, timezone, branding, connections and email settings.
Guard against prompt injection in base instructions, and validate generated workflow graphs against the same node kinds the engine can run.
Score agent conversations with a fixed-temperature LLM evaluator for strengths, weaknesses and sentiment.
